contract.description: The Memory.Init.__init__ method should accept both lists and MemoryData.Init objects, and should properly validate and store the initialization data. Error messages should match expected patterns exactly.

contract.description: The Memory.__init__ method should properly validate and handle the shape parameter, ensuring compatibility with both old and new APIs.
